title: General Amplifier
text: Model nonlinear amplifier described by object or file data, {Interpolation method} sets Method to interpolate network parameters; {Data source}, {Data file} sets the name of file that contains amplifier data, {RFDATA object} sets the rF data object that contains amplifier data, {Noise type} sets the type of noise data, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the available signal-to-noise ratio at the input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Minimum noise figure} sets the minimum ratio of available signal-to-noise ratio at input to available signal-to-noise ratio, {Optimal reflection coefficient} sets the optimal source impedance, {Equivalent normalized noise resistance} sets the normalized resistance values used to take noise, {Noise factor} sets the ratio of available signal-to-noise power at input to available signal-to-noise power, {Noise temperature (K)} sets the equivalent temperature that produces the same amount of noise, {Frequency (Hz)} sets the domain of frequencies to express noise data, {IP3 type} sets the type of third order, {IP3 (dBm)} sets the iP3 value, {1dB gain compression power (dBm)} sets the output power value at which gain has decreased by 1 dB, {Output saturation power (dBm)} sets the output power value that amplifier produces when fully saturated, {Gain compression at saturation (dB)} sets the decrease in gain value, {Source of frequency data} sets the frequency data source Extracted from data, {Frequency data (Hz)} sets the frequency data range, {Source of input power} sets the input power source, {Input power data (dBm)} sets the input power data range, {Reference impedance (ohms)}, {Plot type} sets the type of data plot, {Y parameter1} sets the type of parameters, {Y parameter2} sets the type of parameters, {Y format1} plots format Magnitude, {Y format2} plots format Magnitude, {X parameter} sets the frequency plot, {X format} sets the frequency plot format, {Y scale} sets the y-axis scale, {X scale} sets the x-axis scale, {Plot} and {Bias} sets the amplifier bias. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Data source
params.values: Data source that describes the amplifier behavior Data file (default) | RFDATA object

params.name: Data file
params.values: Name of file that contains amplifier data default.s2d (default) | string | character vector

params.name: RFDATA object
params.values: RF data object that contains amplifier data read(rfdata.data, ’default.amp’) (default) | rfdata.data object

params.name: Interpolation method
params.values: Method to interpolate network parameters Linear (default) | Spline | Cubic

params.name: Noise type
params.values: Type of noise data Noise figure (default) | Spot noise data | Noise factor | Noise temperature

params.name: Noise figure (dB)
params.values: Available signal-to-noise ratio at the input to available signal-to-noise ratio at the output 0 (default) | scalar ratio | vector of ratios

params.name: Minimum noise figure
params.values: Minimum ratio of available signal-to-noise ratio at input to available signal-to-noise ratio at output 0 (default) | scalar ratio | vector of ratios

params.name: Optimal reflection coefficient
params.values: Optimal source impedance 1+0i (default) | complex scalar | complex vector

params.name: Equivalent normalized noise resistance
params.values: Normalized resistance values used to take noise measurement 1 (default) | positive scalar | positive vector

params.name: Noise factor
params.values: Ratio of available signal-to-noise power at input to available signal-to-noise power at output 1 (default) | scalar ratio | vector of ratios

params.name: Noise temperature (K)
params.values: Equivalent temperature that produces the same amount of noise as amplifier 0 (default) | nonnegative scalar | nonnegative vector

params.name: Frequency (Hz)
params.values: Domain of frequencies to express noise data 2.0e9 (default) | nonnegative scalar | nonnegative vector

params.name: IP3 type
params.values: Type of third order intercept OIP3 (default) | IIP3

params.name: IP3 (dBm)
params.values: IP3 value inf (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: 1dB gain compression power (dBm)
params.values: Output power value at which gain has decreased by 1 dB inf (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Output saturation power (dBm)
params.values: Output power value that amplifier produces when fully saturated inf (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Gain compression at saturation (dB)
params.values: Decrease in gain value 3 (default) | scalar | vector

params.name: Source of frequency data
params.values: Frequency data source Extracted from data source (default) | User-specified

params.name: Frequency data (Hz)
params.values: Frequency data range [1e9:1e8:2.9e9] (default) | vector

params.name: Source of input power
params.values: Input power source User-specified (default) | Extracted from data source

params.name: Input power data (dBm)
params.values: Input power data range [0:19] (default) | vector

params.name: Reference impedance (ohms)
params.values: Reference impedance 50 (default) | nonnegative scalar

params.name: Plot type
